quote.summary: Jiangsu Xinde Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company primarily engaged in developing packaging design, offering customized packaging products as well as packaging product testing service. The Company mainly operates two segments. The Providing Packaging Products and Testing Service segment is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of packaging products, as well as providing semiconductor assembly and testing services. The packaging products primarily include quad flat no-lead (QFN), ball grid array (BGA), land grid array (LGA) and wafer-level packaging (WLP). The Others segment is primarily engaged in the sales of scrap and materials. The Company operates its businesses in the domestic market and overseas markets.
